data.name: OutBreak: The Last Survivor
data.detailed_description:
OUTBREAK: THE LAST SURVIVOR The outbreak didn't start with explosions. It started with silence.

OutBreak: The Last Survivor is a multiplayer post-apocalyptic survival game where trust is fragile, resources are scarce, and every decision matters. Enter a ruined world where civilization has collapsed, and your only goal is to survive one more day. Will you form alliances or trust no one? There is no scripted story—the narrative is created entirely by your choices and player interactions.

🔥 CORE FEATURES

  • Dual Perspective Gameplay: Switch seamlessly between First-Person for intense, immersive combat and Third-Person for wider environmental awareness and tactical positioning. Your perspective dictates your survival strategy.

  • Dynamic Multiplayer Encounters: Every player is a mystery. Are they a cautious ally, a neutral survivor, or a desperate looter? Read their body language and distance. Trust can save you, or get you killed.

  • Unforgiving Open World: Explore dense pine forests, collapsed highways, and partially destroyed cities. Every environment offers multiple tactical approaches and high-risk, high-reward looting zones.

  • Deep Survival Mechanics: Ammo and medical supplies are scarce. Manage your resources carefully while navigating dynamic weather, fog, and low-visibility conditions where sound is your best warning.

  • High-Stakes Looting: Every building you enter is a risk. Decide quickly: do you expose your position for better gear, or play it safe and stay hidden?

🌍 A PROJECT BUILT WITH PASSION OutBreak is proudly developed by a two-person team: a father and his 14-year-old son. Every mechanic, environment, and line of code is the result of learning, testing, and a deep passion for game development. By joining OutBreak, you aren't just buying a game; you are supporting a dedicated indie journey that will continuously evolve. All future updates, including new vehicles, weapons, and expanded locations, are completely free for owners of the game.

Welcome to the outbreak. Trust no one. Survive at all costs.

data.short_description: OutBreak: The Last Survivor is an intense multiplayer survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world. Seamlessly switch between first and third-person as you scavenge for scarce resources, manage your inventory, and face unpredictable players. Trust no one, survive at all costs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: i5/Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The requirements, whether minimum or maximum, may vary as updates or patches arise.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: i5/Ryzen5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The requirements, whether minimum or maximum, may vary as updates or patches arise.
